title: fix(web): tidy calibration popup copy and drop antenna offset placeholders
body:
Small UI polish, stacked on #53 (the calibration-step copy lives there).

- Calibration steps: `한 칸 길이를 아래에 입력` → `한 칸 길이를 입력`; remove `단단하게` from the fix-the-board step.
- Antenna manual offset inputs (a_x / a_y): remove the `placeholder` values (300 / 50).

Base is `feat/stereo-calibrate-ui` (PR #53) because two of the three edits touch copy added there; GitHub retargets this to `main` once #53 merges.

## Test
- web: `npm run build` green.
